rationale: This is PersistentNonDepAccrualDeficitStress (the archive's best signal: fmb -2.97, alpha -0.043) with a single IND_ADJ wrapper on the accrual leg and an otherwise identical gate — a one-operator cosmetic variant of an existing result whose core (working-capital accruals scaled by assets) is already the Sloan accrual anomaly, so any incremental finding will be hard to attribute to the new element.

Arithmetically the numerator reduces to roughly -(recch + aoloch + residual) — i.e., receivable buildup plus opaque accruals — which is PayablesExcludedAccrualCashDrain (gen 7, fmb -1.48) with one extra term added back and a byte-identical liquidity gate, and it overlaps directly with the already-tested ReceivableBuildWithoutSupplierFinance and OpaqueAssetBuildShortDebtDrain constructions.

aoloch is already a flow (a change), so DELTA of it is a second difference — mechanically noisy and reversal-prone — and the conditioning block is character-for-character the gate of OpaqueAssetBuildShortDebtDrain (gen 6, fmb -2.49), making this a level-to-change cosmetic respecification of an existing archive signal rather than a new mechanism.

This is AccrualLiabilityDeterioration (gen 7, fmb -0.45, ls_talpha -1.44) with a LAG added to an already 3-year-averaged accrual, meaning the signal uses information up to four years stale, and the "stockpile exposed by subsequent deterioration" story is already covered by PriorAccrualReversalDistress — adding a lag to a weak prior signal is not a substantive improvement.

The construction is internally consistent (recch sign convention handled correctly, sensible mirrored short leg), but the core "sales growth not converted to cash" is essentially the published Abarbanell–Bushee receivables signal / Beneish DSRI and closely echoes the archive's ReceivableSalesBreakDeficitSpread and ReceivableBuildWithoutSupplierFinance, so the incremental content is limited to the conjunctive MIN structure.

This keeps the accrual core that carried the strongest archive evidence but replaces half the conditioning state with a genuinely new, economically motivated variable — a deterioration in debt maturity structure (rollover risk) rather than static leverage — and is internally consistent in sign; the main risks are coverage attrition among low/zero-debt firms and high correlation with the existing gen-6 winner, which should be checked directly.
